# Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know about TaaSFlow subscription sourcing.

TaaSFlow is a subscription recruiting service — you pay a flat monthly fee instead of a percentage of salary, and we deliver pre-screened, ranked candidates on a fixed cadence. The questions below cover the topics buyers ask most often before starting a pilot: how the subscription works, how candidates are sourced and scored, what happens when a role changes mid-cycle, and how we handle data privacy, contracts, and cancellation.

Can't find your answer? Jump to contact us or start a pilot and a hiring lead will walk you through the specifics for your roles and hiring volume.

## Common questions

### Are you a staffing agency?
